earnings.title: REALTY INCOME ANNOUNCES OPERATING RESULTS FOR
highlights: Net income available to common stockholders was $403.9 million, or $0.43 per share
The annualized dividend amount as of September 30, 2026 was $3.258 per share.

The amount of monthly dividends paid per share increased 0.7% to $0.813 in the three months ended September 30, 2026 , as compared to $0.807 during the three months ended September 30, 2025 , representing 72.6% of our diluted AFFO per share of $1.12 during the three months ended September 30, 2026.
Gain on sales of real estate $ 113.9 $ 187.8

quotes.text: We delivered another quarter of strong operating performance, reflecting the resilience of Realty Income’s business model, the quality of our portfolio, and the consistent execution of our team.
quotes.by: Sumit Roy, President and Chief Executive Officer of Realty Income
